title: Azimut Fly 82
highlights: Upgraded triple Volvo Penta IPS 1350 (1,000 hp)
Hydraulic tender hauling system and telescopic gangway
description:
This Azimut Fly 82 is a 2027 model-year flybridge yacht, with exterior lines by Alberto Mancini and an interior by Fabio Fantolino. Built in carbon fibre and GRP, she offers four guest cabins for eight guests, plus crew quarters for two.

She is fitted with the upgraded triple Volvo Penta IPS 1350 engines (1,000 hp each) for up to 32 knots, a Seakeeper 26 stabiliser, upgraded 120,000 BTU air conditioning, a proportional bow thruster and the Garmin Gold electronics package.

On board, the flybridge has a barbecue, icemaker and teak deck, while the heads are finished in Cotton White natural stone. Options also include a tender hauling system, telescopic gangway, Deck2Deck and an exterior luxury lighting package.
